outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: (a) the commit stage is now the commit verb's own runs added up - `commit_verb` times each run_verb of commit-task-work.py (the refused commit, the --json re-read of its refusal, the commit made) into ctx[COMMIT_MS], close_task sums them; the set-aside's proof and second gate between them stay their own stages. Basis now `commit-task-work.py's own N run(s), timed by the drive and added up, commit <sha>`. (b) new `close_carrying` is the one way the drive closes a task: close_task's done and the no-change answer's `done --no-change` both go through it, carrying stage_args and dropping the queue only once the close is taken; prose (--intent-basis, --reason) still goes on stdin through a `_verb_with_text` call written at each call site (the mt2/mt3 argv-prose lint reads that shape). (c) new `stage_unread` says `timing: <kind> stage of <task> not recorded - <why>` on the did-line, once per stage and reason (kept under the task's timing entry as `unread`, dropped with it at close), never a warning or stop; `ledger_row` and new `gate_row_read` return (row, why) - an unreadable ledger's reason names no run, so the launch read and the repeat read of one measurement say it once; `row_stages` returns (pairs, gaps) for a row with no start or no durationMs; `agent_stage` returns (stage, why) for a hand-out with no stamp, an unreadable filing time, or a filing before its hand-out; a gate output naming no run stays silent. (d) `filed_moment` reads the journal only for ROW_FILED_ROLES (executor) and its basis says which fallback happened: journal unreadable (with the exception), no row names the file, or - for a reviewer - that no row files one and a modification time moves later, never earlier. tests/test_drive_phase.py: new staged block tm10-block (`_timing_close_cases`, `_timing_unread_cases`, `_timing_gap_cases`) with tm10-tm16. tests/test_audit_task.py: tmg8 in tmg-block. audit-task.py unchanged: its `_stage_changes` already names timing.stages on both rows; tmg8 locks it.
